title: AIN/AIIN whole-form types: content and container-for-content
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED. In the already exposed complete ZL3b f106r.42-47 paragraph, qokain and qokaiin co-occur with ykar and cheedy in f106r.46, while qokain repeats in .43 and .47. A finite global typed constructor treats qokain as CONTENT and qokaiin as CONTAINER_FOR(content), yielding one explicit containment edge without importing the old water, air or vessel glosses.

design.phase: Bounded concept/source review; no experiment or decoder.
design.epistemic_boundary: The AIN/AIIN ending contrast is only a whole-form family hypothesis. The type labels are opaque working roles, not confirmed meanings or a target translation.
design.access: Existing exposed W80 report-owned text and existing GDT/W94-W96 reports only. No new target data, image, reserve, sealed folio, mixed TSV, contact, route, ledger or publication.

target.paragraph: ZL3b f106r.42-f106r.47, six complete report-owned lines from research_registry/proposals/translation_programs_20260912/work/W80/READING.md.
target.relation_line: f106r.46 sotchdaiin shodaiin otedy qokeedy qokaiin ykar qokain cheedy lol
target.repeated_form_context: qokain also occurs in f106r.43 and f106r.47 under the same proposed CONTENT type; all six lines remain in scope.

global_constructor.local_reduction: PREFACE_A(sotchdaiin) PREFACE_B(shodaiin) ORIGIN(otedy) ASSERT(qokeedy) CONTAINER(qokaiin) BIND(ykar) CONTENT(qokain) CONTAINS(cheedy) CLOSE(lol)
global_constructor.scope_rule: The relation consumes the co-present typed endpoints in f106r.46; no nearest-line lookup, unprinted object or filler group is added. Other paragraph groups remain constraints rather than silently deleted meanings.

design.consequence: The declared constructor predicts CONTAINS(qokaiin, qokain) at f106r.46. Swapping the forms or assigning both the same content type breaks the typed edge while preserving surface spelling. Repeated qokain in .43/.47 must retain CONTENT globally.
rivals: GDT559 carrier rival: AIN=ANTEIL and AIIN=WERT are interchangeable argument values and imply no containment edge.
GDT818 vapour/basin rival: solkeey and chedy carry the becomes/contains distinction; qokaiin is used in an air/conditional tail, not typed as qokain's container in f106r.
Orthographic-only rival: qokain/qokaiin have no stable type difference; this removes the predicted typed relation.
limits: qokain/qokaiin may be independent values under another grammar; no independent container anchor exists.
cheedy may not be a containment predicate and ykar may not bind the two endpoints.
Singleton framing roles remain opaque and are not evidence for English words.
The proposal supplies no source-to-target meaning binding and cannot be selected without a second complete exposed paragraph obeying the same types.
design.distinctness: This is a typed whole-form relation in f106r.42-47, distinct from GDT559's carrier-value grammar, GDT818's solkeey/chedy vapour-basin matrix, and W94-W96's mass/grade/identity branches. It does not adopt qokain=water, qokaiin=air or qokaiin=vessel.
